The '''Terrelia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] at coordinates L-14.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the home of the [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Jango Jumpers" /> and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Terrelia/Legends|Terrelia]].<ref name="JCF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Terrelia system was first mentioned in the [[March 15]], [[2011]] update to ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]'', a series of online appendices published on [[StarWars.com]] to supplement the text of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EAOC" />
